title: A1 mutation adequacy on real code

predictions.claim: Baseline. The null mutant (the unmutated pinned files in a scratch copy), re-extracted from scratch with I17 and I18 and projected onto the holon-facts/0.1 header schema, decides the 8 laws/M0 statements exactly as results/M0 does: L_par_hdr_v0, L_par_hdr_v1, L_rt_go_v0, L_rt_go_v1 and L_rt_go_v2 PROVED; L_par_hdr_v2, L_par_hdr_ssvh and L_dom_hdr REFUTED. Its extraction succeeds.

All 22 mstore_offset mutants (the literal K of mstore(add(p, K), v) to K-1 and K+1 at the 11 store sites of BatchHeaderCodecV0.sol:144-229 and BatchHeaderCodecV1.sol:56) are killed (K1 or K2): M001-M020 with L_par_hdr_v0 among the killing laws, M021 and M022 (storeLastBlockNumber) with L_par_hdr_v1.

shl_width: the 8 mutants of the codec stores' shl(192, v) (to 184 and 200) are killed (K1 or K2), M023-M028 with L_par_hdr_v0 and M029-M030 with L_par_hdr_v1; the 4 in Rollup._commitBatch (Rollup.sol:871 shl(192) and :873 shl(240), the data-hash preimage, M031-M034) survive.

cmp_boundary: of the 16 mutants (>= to > and > to >=; BatchHeaderCodecV0.sol:32 and 15 sites of Rollup.sol), exactly M052 and M053 (Rollup.sol:333 and :353, the 'version >= 1' of the header length and of storeLastBlockNumber) are killed, each with L_par_hdr_v1 among its killing laws (K1 or K2); M049-M051 and M054-M064 survive although the predicted set is every law of the baseline.

None of the 6 drop_delete mutants (M035 revertBatch Rollup.sol:453 'delete challenges[_batchIndex]', M036 setPause :580, M037-M040 finalizeBatch :657-660) is killed. The plan expected the UNDO laws to kill the dropped delete in revertBatch: on this pipeline the rollup laws are decided on I20's window view, which takes every effect from the hand abstraction.

None of the 8 swap_cursor mutants (lastCommittedBatchIndex <-> lastFinalizedBatchIndex at the reads Rollup.sol:312, :389, :417, :441, :476, :489 twice, :643; M041-M048) is killed by a law, and I20's corpus detects 7 of them (corpus_detected true: M041, M043, M044, M045, M046, M047, M048), grounded on the unmutated corpus in the instrument's computation item 9 (300 ok commits with lastCommittedBatchIndex != lastFinalizedBatchIndex; 17 ok commitBatchWithProof, 55 ok revertBatch, 39 ok challengeState of which 22 with another unfinalized batch, 10 ok finalizeBatch). Nothing is predicted for M042's corpus.

For all 110 mutants the normalized decided input of the M1x set (gen/M2/extracted/m1_view.json, I20's window view: the hand abstraction minus the requires of its guard_missing deltas, matched by span) is byte-identical to the baseline's: no mutant removes or moves a checked span. So each of the 15 rollup laws keeps its baseline status in every mutant run.

For the 30 Rollup.sol mutants outside the header edges' store sequences and loader (M031-M048, M050, M051, M054-M062, M064) the normalized projected header document is byte-identical to the baseline's: storage conditions are projected away (A-env) and the data-hash preimage is not a header op.

All 14 putuint64_offset mutants (binary.BigEndian.PutUint64(x[K:], v) to K-1 and K+1 at batch_header.go:218-220 and :246-248, :256) are killed (K1 or K2): M065-M070 (BatchHeaderV0.Bytes) with L_par_hdr_v0 and M071-M078 (BatchHeaderV1.Bytes) with L_par_hdr_v1, M078 included (PutUint64 on the 7-byte slice batchBytes[250:], which panics for every header).

copy_offset: 26 of the 28 mutants (copy(x[K:], y) to K-1 and K+1 at batch_header.go:221-227 and :249-255) are killed (K1 or K2), M079-M092 but M090 with L_par_hdr_v0 and M093-M106 but M104 with L_par_hdr_v1. M090 and M104 (the sequencerSetVerifyHash copy shifted to 186) survive: every PROVED codec law pins sequencerSetVerifyHash to zero, so the shifted zero bytes equal the original ones, and L_par_hdr_ssvh is REFUTED in the baseline.

None of the 4 drop_len_check mutants (validate's length checks at batch_header.go:44, :48, :52 and Version's empty check at :73; M107-M110) is killed: L_dom_hdr is REFUTED in the baseline (the 250-byte version-0 header) and cannot move, and the round-trip laws decode only exact-length encodings. The plan expected the domain law to kill them.

Totals: 72 of the 110 mutants are killed (rate_all 72/110 = 0.6545), no mutant ends in error, no unpredicted obstruction occurs, and rate_non_equivalent is below 0.80: M2 exit (b) is not met at this pipeline (it would need at least 20 of the 38 survivors adjudicated equivalent).

extraction_defect_detected (a replay disagreement of a law, or a new disagreement of a channel run): for the 30 Rollup-only mutants and the 41 Go mutants whose code runs on I16's per-edge corpus without a panic (M065-M077, M079-M106), no law is a replay disagreement and every channel run completes with no disagreement the baseline's run does not have (false). M078 and M107-M110 panic on that corpus (computation item 10): their i16_edge run is incomplete, no law is a replay disagreement and no run reports a new disagreement (null).

The frontends see every planted change: each of the 110 mutants changes at least one extracted document after normalization (its top-level extraction block removed). No survivor is an extraction gap at the frontend stage; every miss is lost after extraction (gap_stage model) or is a rule gap.

regressions.claim: Gates M0, M1 and M2 pass at the iteration's last commit. I22 changes no law, statement, facts document, extracted document or result record outside results/M2/mutation/ and results/M2/mutation_adequacy.json (the gate's regenerated results/M2/metrics.json gains only its mutation_adequacy entry), and never writes to the pinned checkout or to spec/M2/disagreements.json.

Construction: the projection of the committed extracted documents equals the frozen header facts where I17 and I18 compared them (enc_sol layouts for versions 0, 1, 2; enc_go_v0, enc_go_v1; the dec_go getters; ok_sol and ok_go on I17's loader grid), and holon mutate project --check reproduces it.

Construction: the frozen instrument and diff sheet are intact (sha256 pinned; every mutant is its operator's rewrite of the pinned bytes; the sheet is the reference rendering); holon.mutate.operators enumerates exactly the 110 mutants; holon/mutate names nothing of the target; mutate sheet --check reproduces the sheet; run --dry-run refuses (exit 2, nothing written) a missing, unparsable or incomplete adjudication, one of another catalog or sheet, or one without the sign-off, and accepts (exit 0, nothing written) a complete, signed-off one.

regressions.claim: Construction: the human's adjudication covers the 110 mutants of this catalog with the catalog signed off and was committed alone, after the instrument and before any result; the baseline decides every set and reproduces the committed statuses (results/M0, results/M2/differential.json "extracted", results/M2 over the committed laws/M2), the committed spec/M2/facts documents and the committed projection; every record covers the baseline law set; every changed flag equals a hash comparison with the baseline; every record lists exactly its channel runs (i20_step at least 2432 steps when complete); replay disagreements, kill decisions (K1 needs a witness replaying on the mutant and not on the original; K2 is PROVED to UNKNOWN on a changed input), channel flags, survivor classes and both rates are recomputed from the records; the pinned checkout is untouched; a sample reruns identically at the pipeline commit with --no-carry.

regressions.claim: Exit (BUILD_PLAN I22, M2 exit (b)): rate_non_equivalent >= 0.80, recomputed by test. I22-P12 forecasts that it fails; the threshold never moves.

Whitepaper §13 metric 'mutation adequacy' and §12.1 'Sensitivity' (certificates report it): results/M2/metrics.json reports mutation_adequacy {source results/M2/mutation_adequacy.json, threshold 0.8, rate_all, rate_non_equivalent, meets_threshold} equal to the summary's, and the metric leaves not_applicable.
